title: Health Roadmap record file
description: The complete health record for one user: a single JSON document named health-roadmap.json, stored in the user's own cloud (Google Drive, Dropbox, GitHub, WebDAV) or in browser localStorage. Never on our server. Derived from packages/health-core/src/roadmap-file.ts at schemaVersion 1. Unknown properties are preserved on read and write (forward-compatibility rule 1 in migrate.ts), so every object here allows extra keys. Timestamps are ISO 8601 strings. `meta.createdAt`/`meta.updatedAt` are shape-checked on read (a malformed value is replaced with the load time); row timestamps are compared as strings and clamped, not format-validated — so this schema does not require a format. Agents: see docs/agent-access.md for the read/write rules.

schemaVersion.description: On-disk shape version. A file with a HIGHER version than the reading app understands must not be rewritten — migrate.ts throws SchemaTooNewError rather than downgrade it.

measurements.description: Append-only. Core metric values in SI canonical units.

medications.description: Current state, one row per medicationKey.

supplements.description: Current state, one row per supplementKey.

labValues.description: Append-only. Lab tests beyond the core metrics, kept in the lab's own reported unit.

documents.description: Metadata for uploaded reports. The bytes live beside this file, at fileRef.

reminderPreferences.description: Current state, one row per reminder category.

recommendationSnapshots.description: Point-in-time record of what the tool advised, deduped by date.

RoadmapFileMeta.description: Top-level sync state for the whole file. An agent writing the file sets `updatedAt` and nothing else here — `lamport`, `eraseEpoch` and `lastDeviceId` belong to the sync engine. Unrecognised keys added here are dropped by mergeFiles, which rebuilds meta from these five fields. `updatedAt` also anchors the clock clamp on read — a stale value rewinds rows written after it.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 — last write to the file.

lamport.description: File-level logical clock, monotonic per device.

eraseEpoch.description: "Delete All My Data" counter. A file with a higher epoch wins a merge wholesale. Absent reads as 0.

RoadmapProfile.description: Demographics and display preferences. A last-write-wins singleton.

unitSystem.description: Display units only; stored values are always SI.

unitOverrides.description: Per-metric display-unit overrides, keyed by metric type.

reportEmailCaptured.description: Monotonic: set true once the user submits an email for their plan. Never set back to false.

MetricType.description: The core metrics, from METRIC_TYPES in packages/health-core/src/validation.ts. Anything outside this list belongs in labValues. Height is not here — it lives in profile.heightCm, not as a measurement row.

MeasurementSource.description: Where the value came from. From MEASUREMENT_SOURCES in packages/health-core/src/validation.ts.

MeasurementStatus.description: FHIR-style audit state. One-way: active may become entered-in-error, never the reverse.

FileMeasurement.description: One immutable measurement row. Never edit or delete a row — append a correction instead.

id.description: Stable unique id. Write a fresh UUID; never reuse one. Read ids as opaque strings: an id containing '#dup-' is a quarantined duplicate the merge created after an id was reused with different content — never write one yourself.

value.description: SI canonical unit: kg, cm, mmHg, mmol/mol (HbA1c), mmol/L (lipids), g/L (ApoB), µmol/L (creatinine), ng/mL (PSA), nmol/L (Lp(a)).

recordedAt.description: ISO 8601. Only the calendar day matters: (metricType, day) is the slot key, and at most one active row exists per slot. Both 'YYYY-MM-DD' and a full timestamp occur in real files.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 write time. Within a slot, the newest createdAt is the active row (id breaks ties).

correctsId.description: Id of the row this one replaces, or null.

externalId.description: Id in the originating system (e.g. a HealthKit sample UUID), used for dedup.

FileLabValue.description: One immutable lab row for a test outside the core metrics. Same append-only rules as a measurement.

id.description: Stable unique id. Write a fresh UUID; never reuse one. An id containing '#dup-' is a merge-quarantined duplicate — never write one yourself.

metricName.description: Prefer a catalogue key from packages/health-core/src/lab-catalog.ts (e.g. 'ferritin'). Free text otherwise. Slot key is (metricName, day of recordedAt).

unit.description: The lab's own reported unit. No SI conversion is applied.

referenceLow.description: Lab reference range low, or null.

referenceHigh.description: Lab reference range high, or null.

HistoryChangeType.description: How a history row differs from the state before it. Recorded at write time, present only on medicationHistory / supplementHistory rows.

FileMedication.description: One medication slot. In `medications` this is current state; in `medicationHistory` it is an appended log row.

id.description: Stable unique id. Write a fresh UUID; never reuse one. An id containing '#dup-' is a merge-quarantined duplicate — never write one yourself.

medicationKey.description: MEDICATION_KEYS in validation.ts. The merge key for the current-state list.

FileSupplement.description: One supplement. In `supplements` this is current state; in `supplementHistory` it is an appended log row.

id.description: Stable unique id. Write a fresh UUID; never reuse one. An id containing '#dup-' is a merge-quarantined duplicate — never write one yourself.

supplementKey.description: Lowercase alphanumeric with underscores. The merge key for the current-state list.

status.description: Stopping a supplement flips this; it does not delete the row.

FileScreenings.description: The cancer- and bone-screening workflow, as one last-write-wins singleton. Every field is optional. Date fields use 'YYYY-MM' (month precision).

FileReminderPreference.description: One reminder category the user has switched on or off. Merge key is `category`.

FileReminderOptIn.description: The user's email-reminder opt-in. Cancelling flips status; the object is never removed, because an absent field cannot win a merge.

token.description: Opaque server-issued capability token. It manages ONLY the reminder schedule. Treat it as a secret: never copy it elsewhere, never send it anywhere.

email.description: Provider-verified address, kept for display and change detection.

FileDocument.description: Metadata for one uploaded report or letter. Deletion sets `deleted: true`; the row itself stays forever, or the union merge would resurrect it.

id.description: Stable unique id. Write a fresh UUID; never reuse one. An id containing '#dup-' is a merge-quarantined duplicate — never write one yourself.

type.description: DOCUMENT_TYPES in validation.ts. It decides the archive folder (document-path.ts).

date.description: The document's own date, 'YYYY-MM-DD', or null.

fileRef.description: Path of the stored original relative to the record folder, e.g. 'Lab results/2024-05-10 Lipid panel.pdf'. Empty string when the document is text-only.

contentHash.description: 'sha256-…' over the stored bytes. Empty string when text-only.

extractedText.description: Markdown text of the document, so search works without the original.

sourceFileName.description: Original upload filename. It is the dedup key for re-uploads — stable, unlike any generated title.

deleted.description: Tombstone. Merge ORs it, so a delete is never undone.

Suggestion.description: One piece of advice the tool produced. Generated output — agents read it, they do not author it.

RecommendationSnapshot.description: What the user was advised on one day. Deduped by date.
